description: Seeds one open BTCUSDT position on the scenario it is named with: the position list holds a 0.001 long at 5x with a native stop-loss 300 ticks below its entry, and the three mode-switch calls answer with an open-position refusal whose code is unconfirmed. Closing orders are accepted by the scenario's order create; the fill, after which the list is flat, is state the stub transport keeps (#2893).

merge_patch.retMsg: Mode switch refused: the account holds an open position

POST /v5/position/switch-mode.note: No recording exists. 24-internal-schemas section 8.6 has no open-position refusal of a mode switch, and its one position-mode entry, 110025, is a hard error (alert and block the account) that TC-420 does not expect. So this code is outside the table, and section 8.6's last row applies: a plain reject. 110024 is the exchange's open-position refusal of a position-mode switch from recollection only. The message describes the condition; it is not the exchange's wording (README, unconfirmed codes).
